title: Loop ledger
description: The loop's durable state at .allium-loop/<goal-slug>.json. Typed so a resuming run reads structured state rather than re-parsing prose, and so the witness has a schema'd baseline to re-derive from. Open to extra fields — loop state evolves — but the core is fixed.

generated_test_hashes.description: path -> content hash, written by propagate; the witness tamper baseline

reconciliation.description: propagate's `N obligations, M covered, K uncovered` line

last_results.description: the most recent typed record per phase (distill, weed, tend, propagate, witness)
